description: One marketing play from the library in full: its type, summary, the reusable pattern, its own steps (or a note that the channel’s standard steps apply), constraints, who it suits, what it costs, its standing (backed: a platform doc, law, study, dataset or tool doc was read, or a claim supports it; practitioner: only posts, threads or vendor material; our-idea: no source), each source with how well it was read, the wiki topics that list it and the plan steps that follow it. The slug comes from search_plays, get_topic, get_step or search_knowledge. Read-only; no side effects.
